mapper.select: SELECT e.elderly_id AS elderlyId, e.name AS elderlyName, e.id_number AS idNumber, p.project_name AS projectName, p.nurse_level AS nurseLevel, n.name AS nurseName, r.care_status AS careStatus FROM care_record r JOIN elderly_info e ON r.elderly_id = e.elderly_id JOIN care_project p ON r.project_id = p.project_id JOIN nurse_info n ON r.nurse_id = n.nurse_id WHERE r.status = '1' AND e.status = '1' AND p.status = '1' AND n.status = '1' ORDER BY r.care_start_time DESC;

SELECT ei.elderly_id, -- 老人ID ei.name AS elderly_name, -- 老人姓名 ei.id_number, -- 老人身份证号 cp.project_name AS project_name, -- 护理项目名称 cp.nurse_level, -- 护理等级 ni.name AS nurse_name, -- 护工姓名 cr.care_status -- 护理状态 FROM care_record cr JOIN elderly_info ei ON cr.elderly_id = ei.elderly_id -- 连接老人信息表 JOIN care_project cp ON cr.project_id = cp.project_id -- 连接护理项目信息表 JOIN nurse_info ni ON cr.nurse_id = ni.nurse_id -- 连接护工信息表 WHERE 1 = 1 -- 作为条件的默认值，用于连接动态条件
AND ei.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{elderlyName}, '%') -- 根据老人姓名模糊查询
AND cp.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{projectName}, '%') -- 根据护理项目名称模糊查询
AND cr.status = '1'; -- 仅查询状态为1的有效记录

SELECT ei.name AS elderlyName, ei.id_number AS idNumber, cp.project_name AS projectName, cp.nurse_level AS nurseLevel, ni.name AS nurseName, cr.care_status AS careStatus FROM care_record cr JOIN elderly_info ei ON cr.elderly_id = ei.elderly_id JOIN care_project cp ON cr.project_id = cp.project_id JOIN nurse_info ni ON cr.nurse_id = ni.nurse_id WHERE cr.elderly_id = #{elderlyId}
SELECT care_status FROM care_record WHERE elderly_id = #{elderlyId}
SELECT name, gender, age, id_number, nurse_name, project_name, description, care_status, service_duration, price FROM service_concern_and_record
